import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';
import { createRequire } from 'node:module';
const { chromium, webkit } = await import(process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE);
const { PNG } = createRequire(import.meta.url)(process.env.PNG_MODULE);
const out = process.env.QA_OUTPUT;
await fs.mkdir(out, { recursive: true });
const report = { checks: [], runtimeErrors: [], submissions: [], comparisons: [] };
const APP = 'http://127.0.0.1:4173';
const BASE = 'http://127.0.0.1:4174';
const DEV = 'http://127.0.0.1:4193';
const targets = '[data-contact-reveal]';
const pending = '[data-contact-reveal-state="pending"]';
const png = Buffer.from('iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAQAAAC1HAwCAAAAC0lEQVR42mP8/x8AAwMCAO+jvHsAAAAASUVORK5CYII=', 'base64');

async function mount(page, route = '/contact', origin = APP) {
  await page.goto(origin + route, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
  await page.locator('main h1').waitFor();
  await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
}
async function finish(page) {
  await page.evaluate(async () => {
    const images = [...document.images];
    images.forEach((img) => { img.loading = 'eager'; });
    await Promise.all(images.map((img) => img.decode()));
  });
  const height = await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollHeight);
  for (let y = 0; y < height; y += 480) {
    await page.evaluate((top) => window.scrollTo({ top, behavior: 'instant' }), y);
    await page.waitForTimeout(35);
  }
  await page.waitForTimeout(750);
  await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'instant' }));
  await page.waitForTimeout(180);
}
async function assertFormStatic(page) {
  assert.equal(await page.locator('.inquiry-form [data-contact-reveal]').count(), 0);
  assert.deepEqual(await page.locator('.inquiry-form').evaluate((el) => {
    const chain = [];
    for (let n = el; n; n = n.parentElement) {
      const css = getComputedStyle(n);
      chain.push(css.opacity === '1' && css.transform === 'none' && css.visibility === 'visible' && css.pointerEvents !== 'none');
    }
    return chain.every(Boolean);
  }), true);
}
async function assertRevealed(page) {
  assert.equal(await page.locator(pending).count(), 0);
  assert.equal(await page.locator(targets).evaluateAll((els) => els.every((el) => {
    const css = getComputedStyle(el);
    return css.opacity === '1' && css.transform === 'none';
  })), true);
}
async function check(browser, engine, name, fn, options = {}) {
  const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 1000 }, reducedMotion: 'no-preference', ...options });
  const page = await context.newPage();
  page.setDefaultTimeout(12000);
  page.setDefaultNavigationTimeout(20000);
  const errors = [];
  page.on('pageerror', (error) => errors.push(error.message));
  page.on('request', (request) => {
    if (['POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE'].includes(request.method())) report.submissions.push({ engine, name, url: request.url(), method: request.method() });
  });
  try {
    await fn(page);
    assert.deepEqual(errors, []);
    report.checks.push({ engine, name, passed: true });
    console.log('PASS', engine, name);
  } catch (error) {
    const screenshot = `${engine}-failure-${report.checks.length}.png`;
    await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(out, screenshot) }).catch(() => {});
    report.checks.push({ engine, name, passed: false, error: String(error.stack || error), screenshot });
    console.error('FAIL', engine, name, error.message);
  } finally {
    report.runtimeErrors.push(...errors.map((message) => ({ engine, name, message })));
    await context.close();
  }
}

for (const [engine, type] of Object.entries({ chromium, webkit })) {
  const browser = await type.launch();
  for (const width of [320, 390, 700, 701, 768, 900, 1100, 1101, 1440, 1920]) {
    await check(browser, engine, `layout-${width}`, async (page) => {
      await mount(page);
      await page.waitForSelector(targets, { state: 'attached' });
      assert.equal(await page.locator(targets).count(), 9);
      await assertFormStatic(page);
      assert.equal(await page.locator('h1').count(), 1);
      assert.equal(await page.locator('.header').count(), 1);
      assert.equal(await page.locator('.footer').count(), 1);
      const timing = await page.locator('.contact-page').evaluate((el) => {
        const css = getComputedStyle(el);
        return ['--contact-reveal-duration', '--contact-reveal-stagger', '--contact-reveal-distance'].map((key) => css.getPropertyValue(key).trim());
      });
      const seconds = (value) => parseFloat(value) / (value.endsWith('ms') ? 1000 : 1);
      assert.equal(seconds(timing[0]), width <= 700 ? 0.36 : width <= 1100 ? 0.42 : 0.48);
      assert.equal(seconds(timing[1]), width <= 700 ? 0 : width <= 1100 ? 0.04 : 0.06);
      assert.equal(parseFloat(timing[2]), width <= 700 ? 10 : width <= 1100 ? 14 : 18);
      await finish(page);
      await assertRevealed(page);
      assert.equal(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth), true);
      assert.equal(await page.evaluate(() => [...document.images].every((img) => img.complete && img.naturalWidth > 0)), true);
      if ([390, 1440].includes(width)) await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(out, `${engine}-contact-${width}.png`), fullPage: true });
    }, { viewport: { width, height: width <= 700 ? 844 : 1000 } });
  }

  await check(browser, engine, '15-percent-threshold-real-motion-and-no-resize-replay', async (page) => {
    await mount(page);
    const figure = page.locator('.contact-map__figure');
    assert.equal(await figure.getAttribute('data-contact-reveal-state'), 'pending');
    const showFraction = async (fraction) => {
      await figure.evaluate((el, ratio) => {
        const box = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        window.scrollTo({ top: scrollY + box.top - innerHeight + box.height * ratio, behavior: 'instant' });
      }, fraction);
    };
    await showFraction(0.1);
    await page.waitForTimeout(180);
    assert.equal(await figure.getAttribute('data-contact-reveal-state'), 'pending');
    await showFraction(0.35);
    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.querySelector('.contact-map__figure').dataset.contactRevealState === 'visible');
    await page.waitForTimeout(70);
    const middle = await figure.evaluate((el) => ({ opacity: Number(getComputedStyle(el).opacity), transform: getComputedStyle(el).transform, running: el.getAnimations().length }));
    assert(middle.opacity > 0 && middle.opacity < 1, JSON.stringify(middle));
    assert.notEqual(middle.transform, 'none');
    assert(middle.running > 0);
    await page.waitForTimeout(600);
    for (const width of [900, 390, 1440]) {
      await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 1000 });
      await page.waitForTimeout(80);
      assert.equal(await figure.evaluate((el) => getComputedStyle(el).opacity === '1' && getComputedStyle(el).transform === 'none'), true);
    }
  });

  await check(browser, engine, 'form-validation-files-console-submit-and-return', async (page) => {
    await mount(page);
    await assertFormStatic(page);
    await page.locator('#contact-name').fill('');
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send Message', exact: true }).click();
    await page.locator('.inquiry-form__error-summary').waitFor();
    assert.equal(await page.locator('#contact-name').evaluate((el) => el === document.activeElement), true);
    assert.equal(await page.locator('#contact-name').getAttribute('aria-invalid'), 'true');
    await page.locator('#contact-name').fill('Alex Morgan');
    await page.locator('#contact-email').fill('alex@example.com');
    await page.locator('#contact-message').fill('Please discuss my roof.');
    const input = page.locator('.photo-picker input[type="file"]');
    await input.setInputFiles({ name: 'not-a-photo.txt', mimeType: 'text/plain', buffer: Buffer.from('test') });
    await page.locator('#contact-photos-error').waitFor();
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Dismiss file error' }).click();
    await input.setInputFiles([
      { name: 'roof.png', mimeType: 'image/png', buffer: png },
      { name: 'detail.png', mimeType: 'image/png', buffer: png },
    ]);
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.photo-picker__file').count(), 2);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Remove detail.png', exact: true }).click();
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.photo-picker__file').count(), 1);
    await finish(page);
    const before = await page.locator(targets).evaluateAll((els) => els.map((el) => el.dataset.contactRevealState));
    await page.locator('#contact-form').scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
    await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(out, `${engine}-filled-form.png`) });
    const message = page.waitForEvent('console', (event) => event.text().startsWith('[Veldridge Contact demo'));
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send Message', exact: true }).click();
    const payload = await (await message).args()[1].jsonValue();
    assert.equal(payload.mode, 'demo');
    assert.equal(payload.name, 'Alex Morgan');
    assert.equal(payload.email, 'alex@example.com');
    assert.equal(payload.photos.length, 1);
    assert.equal(payload.photos[0].name, 'roof.png');
    assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(payload.photos[0]).sort(), ['lastModified', 'name', 'size', 'type']);
    await page.locator('.inquiry-form__result').waitFor();
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.inquiry-form__result').evaluate((el) => el === document.activeElement), true);
    await assertFormStatic(page);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Back to Form' }).click();
    assert.equal(await page.locator('#contact-name').inputValue(), 'Alex Morgan');
    assert.equal(await page.locator('#contact-message').inputValue(), 'Please discuss my roof.');
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.photo-picker__file').count(), 1);
    assert.deepEqual(await page.locator(targets).evaluateAll((els) => els.map((el) => el.dataset.contactRevealState)), before);
  });

  await check(browser, engine, 'initial-reduced-motion', async (page) => {
    await mount(page);
    assert.equal(await page.locator(targets).count(), 0);
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.contact-map__figure').evaluate((el) => getComputedStyle(el).opacity), '1');
    await assertFormStatic(page);
  }, { reducedMotion: 'reduce' });

  await check(browser, engine, 'live-reduced-motion-and-no-replay', async (page) => {
    await mount(page);
    assert(await page.locator(pending).count() > 0);
    await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'reduce' });
    await page.waitForFunction(() => !document.querySelector('[data-contact-reveal-state="pending"]'));
    await assertRevealed(page);
    await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'no-preference' });
    await finish(page);
    assert.equal(await page.locator('[data-contact-reveal-state="static"]').count(), 9);
  });

  await check(browser, engine, 'missing-observer-fallback', async (page) => {
    await page.addInitScript(() => { window.IntersectionObserver = undefined; });
    await mount(page);
    assert.equal(await page.locator(targets).count(), 0);
    await assertFormStatic(page);
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.contact-map__figure').evaluate((el) => getComputedStyle(el).opacity), '1');
  });

  await check(browser, engine, 'keyboard-focus-immediately-reveals-supporting-content', async (page) => {
    await mount(page);
    const row = page.locator('.contact-details__row').last();
    assert.equal(await row.getAttribute('data-contact-reveal-state'), 'pending');
    // Production contact links are disabled while details are marked as demo.
    // Simulate a focusable real contact item without changing production code.
    await row.evaluate((el) => { el.tabIndex = 0; el.focus({ preventScroll: true }); });
    assert.equal(await row.getAttribute('data-contact-reveal-state'), 'static');
    assert.equal(await row.evaluate((el) => getComputedStyle(el).opacity), '1');
  }, { viewport: { width: 1440, height: 400 } });

  await check(browser, engine, 'fast-scroll-and-print', async (page) => {
    await mount(page);
    await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo({ top: document.documentElement.scrollHeight, behavior: 'instant' }));
    await page.waitForTimeout(750);
    await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'instant' }));
    await page.waitForTimeout(100);
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.contact-details__row[data-contact-reveal-state="pending"]').count(), 0);
    await page.evaluate(() => window.dispatchEvent(new Event('beforeprint')));
    await assertRevealed(page);
    assert.equal(await page.locator('[data-contact-reveal-state="static"]').count(), 9);
  });

  await check(browser, engine, 'direct-form-anchor-immediate-input', async (page) => {
    await mount(page, '/contact#contact-form');
    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.activeElement?.id === 'contact-name');
    await assertFormStatic(page);
    await page.locator('#contact-name').fill('Anchor test');
    assert.equal(await page.locator('#contact-name').inputValue(), 'Anchor test');
  });

  for (const from of ['gallery', 'blog']) {
    await check(browser, engine, `${from}-contact-context-preserved`, async (page) => {
      await mount(page, `/${from}`);
      const opener = page.locator(from === 'gallery' ? '.project-card__button' : '.article-row__open').first();
      const title = from === 'gallery'
        ? (await page.locator('.project-card__title').first().textContent()).trim()
        : (await opener.textContent()).trim();
      await opener.click();
      await page.locator(from === 'gallery' ? '.project-dialog__cta' : '.article-dialog__cta').click();
      await page.locator('.contact-page').waitFor();
      assert((await page.locator('#contact-message').inputValue()).includes(title));
      await assertFormStatic(page);
      await page.locator('#contact-message').fill('Edited request');
      assert.equal(await page.locator('#contact-message').inputValue(), 'Edited request');
    }, { reducedMotion: 'reduce' });
  }

  await check(browser, engine, 'strictmode-route-cleanup', async (page) => {
    await mount(page, '/contact', DEV);
    assert.equal(await page.locator(targets).count(), 9);
    await page.locator('.header__nav-link[href="/about"]').click();
    await page.locator('.about-page').waitFor();
    assert.equal(await page.locator(targets).count(), 0);
    await page.locator('.header__contact').click();
    await page.locator('.contact-page').waitFor();
    assert.equal(await page.locator(targets).count(), 9);
    await page.locator('#contact-name').fill('Strict mode');
    await assertFormStatic(page);
  });

  await check(browser, engine, 'mobile-touch-phone-only-submission', async (page) => {
    await mount(page, '/contact#contact-form');
    await page.locator('#contact-name').fill('Touch test');
    await page.locator('#contact-phone').fill('2155550126');
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send Message', exact: true }).tap();
    await page.locator('.inquiry-form__result').waitFor();
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Back to Form' }).tap();
    assert.equal(await page.locator('#contact-phone').inputValue(), '2155550126');
    await assertFormStatic(page);
  }, { viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 }, isMobile: true, hasTouch: true });

  for (const width of [390, 1440]) {
    await check(browser, engine, `unchanged-pixels-${width}`, async (page) => {
      await mount(page);
      await finish(page);
      const current = await page.screenshot({ fullPage: true });
      await mount(page, '/contact', BASE);
      await finish(page);
      const baseline = await page.screenshot({ fullPage: true });
      const a = PNG.sync.read(current);
      const b = PNG.sync.read(baseline);
      assert.equal(a.width, b.width);
      assert.equal(a.height, b.height);
      let differences = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < a.data.length; i += 4) {
        if (a.data[i] !== b.data[i] || a.data[i + 1] !== b.data[i + 1] || a.data[i + 2] !== b.data[i + 2] || a.data[i + 3] !== b.data[i + 3]) differences++;
      }
      report.comparisons.push({ engine, width, height: a.height, differentPixels: differences });
      if (differences) {
        await fs.writeFile(path.join(out, `${engine}-${width}-current.png`), current);
        await fs.writeFile(path.join(out, `${engine}-${width}-baseline.png`), baseline);
      }
      assert.equal(differences, 0);
    }, { viewport: { width, height: width === 390 ? 844 : 1000 } });
  }
  await browser.close();
}
report.passed = report.checks.filter((item) => item.passed).length;
report.failed = report.checks.filter((item) => !item.passed).length;
await fs.writeFile(path.join(out, 'report.json'), JSON.stringify(report, null, 2));
console.log(JSON.stringify({ passed: report.passed, failed: report.failed, runtimeErrors: report.runtimeErrors.length, submissions: report.submissions.length, comparisons: report.comparisons }, null, 2));
if (report.failed || report.runtimeErrors.length || report.submissions.length) process.exitCode = 1;
